title: Red Sea kinetic escalation gains a diplomatic off-ramp; realized supply shock still unconfirmed
net_new_delta: Relative to durable event 20261002T230912Z_macro_red_sea_confirmed_kinetic_escalation.json, Pakistan says Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan will hold an emergency Riyadh meeting next week to consider Iran's suggestion of political engagement with the Houthis. This introduces a concrete diplomatic off-ramp after confirmed Taiz strikes and reduces confidence in a one-way escalation path, while current oil/LNG evidence still does not confirm realized energy supply disruption.
fact: Yemen's internationally recognized government reported 20 airstrikes on Houthi targets in Taiz on October 2, confirming kinetic escalation.
Brent settled October 2 at $102.25/bbl and WTI at $91.11 after emergency stock-release measures; oil pricing did not confirm a new physical supply shock.
September LNG shipments through Hormuz reached their highest monthly level since the current US-Iran war began, according to shipping analytics cited by Reuters.
source_claim: Pakistan Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar said Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan will hold an emergency meeting in Riyadh next week to discuss Iran's suggestion to engage the Houthis politically.
Reuters reports the larger Saudi-backed Bab el-Mandeb offensive remains under preparation rather than confirmed as launched.
model_inference: Keep RED_SEA_ESCALATION_RISK at CONFIRMED_KINETIC_ESCALATION, but add DIPLOMATIC_OFFRAMP_ACTIVE and reduce confidence in a monotonic escalation trajectory. REALIZED_ENERGY_SUPPLY_DISRUPTION remains unconfirmed.
unknown: Whether the Riyadh meeting produces actionable de-escalation terms or alters military plans.
Whether the larger Saudi-backed offensive launches.
Whether Bab el-Mandeb maritime traffic, freight, insurance or physical petroleum flows deteriorate measurably.
conflicts: Confirmed Taiz strikes and reported offensive planning point toward escalation, while a scheduled emergency political-engagement meeting, emergency petroleum releases, softer oil settlement and improved Hormuz LNG throughput point against assuming an inevitable supply shock.
next_decisive_check: Verify whether the Riyadh meeting yields concrete engagement/ceasefire terms or whether the planned Saudi-backed offensive instead launches; simultaneously require measurable Bab el-Mandeb shipping/freight/refined-product deterioration before promoting to REALIZED_SUPPLY_DISRUPTION.

evidence.topic: Emergency Riyadh talks on political engagement with Houthis
Oil settlement and emergency stock releases

oracle.finding: Confirmed kinetic escalation now has a concrete diplomatic off-ramp; retain the kinetic-risk state but reduce confidence in a monotonic escalation path and keep realized supply disruption unconfirmed.

supermesh_x.finding: Independent Reuters political, military, oil-settlement and LNG-flow evidence supports a two-sided event tree; routing should preserve diplomacy, kinetic activity and physical-flow evidence as separate channels.
